    # Extract basename
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = basename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name, ext = rest, ''
    # New directory name is file_name
    new_dir = base_dir + file_name
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file name: date.ext

    dest_path = new_dir + '/' + new_file_name

    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}")
